findings.title: Managed reversal of the earthly surface
findings.claim: The surface named by what is upon the earth is presented as a state God can actively reassign from adornment to barren ground.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier جَٰعِلُونَ carries state-rendering for an existing object; the adorned garden in 18:32 and its direct conversion to exposed ground in 18:40 return that operation through independent same-surah connections.
findings.reader_payoff: The outcome becomes a governed reversal of an existing condition, so the promise makes the agent and the change of state newly perceptible together.
findings.containment: The ordinary prediction that what is on earth will be made barren remains intact. This does not turn every use of جعل into reversal or supply a timetable beyond the ayah.

epistemic.reason: A citable trusted publication is anchored to the focus carrier, and the exact same-surah target texts independently ground the state-change relation.

findings.title: Active stripping to barren ground
findings.claim: The barren ground is rendered as the result of an active stripping operation that cuts away and removes the surface's visible growth.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier جُرُزًا can carry both the cut/root-removal pressure and the land left without growth; an exposed hard surface after covering is stripped, vegetation becomes scattered debris, and barren land is contrasted with restored production.
findings.reader_payoff: Desolation becomes an enacted clearing of the visible layer, while the plain land-result remains fully recoverable.
findings.containment: The ordinary result, barren ground, remains primary. The activation does not turn the focus into a literal sword scene or assert that every later transformation is one surah-wide system.

epistemic.reason: A citable trusted publication names both focus branches, and the exact target texts supply independent exposed-surface, vegetation-aftermath, and barren-ground triggers.
